children: Civista Bancshares will present its Q2 2026 investor presentation at the Stephens 16th Annual Bank Forum and highlights stronger margins, asset growth and solid capital.
Executive team to present Q2 2026 investor presentation at Stephens Bank Forum Sept 23-24 in Little Rock.
Net interest income reached $38.6M in Q2, driving NIM up 25 bps YoY to 3.89%.
Total assets were $4.29B and tangible book value per share rose to $20.43 (up $2.95 YoY).
Q2 net income $14.3M (+30% YoY); ROAE 10.23% and ROAA 1.34% as of 2Q 2026.
Completed FSB acquisition added ~$268M assets; deposits $3.46B and strong core deposit funding (cost of deposits 1.83%).
